# NBC Sports

> > Comprehensive sports coverage featuring professional and collegiate golf tournaments, major league sports, and championship events across multiple disciplines.

NBC Sports delivers breaking news, tournament results, and in-depth coverage of golf (PGA Tour, LPGA, senior golf), college athletics (UCLA, Michigan State, California), professional baseball (Yankees, Cardinals), basketball (Lakers, Timberwolves), football (Washington Commanders), and international competitions like the World Baseball Classic. The site features expert commentary from Golf Channel newsroom and renowned analysts.

## Key Topics

- PGA Tour and Professional Golf
- Tiger Woods
- College Golf Championships
- Senior Golf Tour
- Golf Channel Coverage
- Tournament Results and Leaderboards
- World Match Play Championship
- NCAA Athletics (UCLA, Michigan State, California)
- Major League Baseball (Yankees, Cardinals)
- NBA Coverage (Lakers, Timberwolves)
- Washington Commanders
- World Baseball Classic
- Big 12 Conference
- European Golf Tour
- Championship Match Play Events

## PGA Tour and Professional Golf

- [Tiger Ties Mark Trails Singh](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-tiger-ties-mark-trails-singh): Tiger Woods matches Byron Nelson's 113 consecutive PGA Tour cuts record
- [Wagner Leads Soggy Gila River](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-wagner-leads-soggy-gila-river): Johnson Wagner fires 8-under 64 before rain suspends Gila River Golf Classic
- [Garcia Leading the Way](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-associated-press-garcia-leading-way): Sergio Garcia posts 4-under 67 for three-stroke lead at Dunlop Phoenix
- [Curtis to Play in Trophee Lancome](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-curtis-play-trophee-lancome): Ben Curtis returns to Europe for Trophee Lancome tournament in Paris
- [Field Set in Spain](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-field-set-spain): High-quality field set for Spanish tournament with Volvo Order of Merit stakes
- [Hamilton Captures Japan Match Play Title](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-golf-channel-newsroom-hamilton-captures-japan-match-play-title): Todd Hamilton defeats David Smail to win Japan PGA Matchplay Championship

## World Match Play and Championship Events

- [Els Ousts Singh Bjorn Gets Revenge](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-els-ousts-singh-bjorn-gets-revenge): Defending champ Ernie Els defeats Vijay Singh 5-and-4 at World Match Play
- [Singh Rolls Into Second Round](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-singh-rolls-second-round): Vijay Singh cruises to 8-and-7 win at HSBC World Match Play Championship
- [Seve Ernie Over Tiger](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-golf-channel-newsroom-seve-ernie-over-tiger): Ernie Els aims to surpass Tiger Woods as world's No. 1 player
- [Norton to Battle Smith In Mid-Amateur Final](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-usga-news-services-norton-battle-smith-mid-amateur-final): Norton and Smith to compete in U.S. Mid-Amateur championship final

## Senior Golf Tour

- [Wins Just Keep Coming for Ol Man Irwin](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-george-white-wins-just-keep-coming-ol-man-irwin): 58-year-old Hale Irwin continues winning streak in senior golf
- [Trio Shares Lead After Round 1](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-trio-shares-lead-after-round-1): Nelson, Sigel, Smyth share first-round lead at Constellation Energy Classic
- [Fleisher Nelson Share Top Spot](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-sports-network-fleisher-nelson-share-top-spot): Fleisher and Nelson post matching 8-under 64s to share tournament lead
- [Thomsen Lays Claim to Senior Club ProTitle](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-golf-channel-newsroom-thomsen-lays-claim-senior-club-protitle): Jeff Thomsen wins 2003 Callaway Golf PGA Senior Club Pro Championship

## College Golf

- [Lady Bruins Remain on Top](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-golf-channel-newsroom-lady-bruins-remain-top): 5th-ranked UCLA women's golf holds first place at Mason Rudolph Championship
- [Bears Storm From 15 Back to Win](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-golf-channel-newsroom-bears-storm-15-back-win): California rallies from 15 back to win Mackenzie Invitational

- [Fun and Games with Daly and Co](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-golf-channel-newsroom-fun-and-games-daly-and-co): Nancy Lopez, Michelle Wie, Hank Kuehne, John Daly team up for exhibition
- [Captains Loose If Not Entirely Healthy](https://www.nbcsports.com/golf/news/article-rich-lerner-captains-loose-if-not-entirely-healthy): Rich Lerner commentary on captains' health and readiness for competition
